method: Author source reading and exact mathematical reconstruction review; this is not an execution on original numerical data.
checks: Direct two-state original cost, transition, polynomial and risk-tail formulas match the frozen mathematical model.
The 32-step odd dyadic cell plus strict lower/non-strict upper derivative signs identifies the original deterministic bisection result, including zero ties.
Exact reconstructed policy and terminal witness dictionaries preserve all saved numerical fields; duplicated upper endpoint atoms are retained.
Only a complete initial ordered716-policy prefix is admissible; partial trailing raw evidence remains separate.
Each segment consumes the old unique request prefix before any new primitive call; checkpoint applies only before the next uncached call after300seconds measured fresh work.
Native fresh-only segment outputs remain untouched; finalizer rejects uncached queries and replays the complete validated trace to a new canonical directory.
Six deterministic final numeric outputs must equal the naturally completed last segment byte for byte.
Shared native manifest validation avoids repeated hashing while rejecting conflicting source manifests.
Primitive counters are not inflated for replay, and actual fresh/cached/composite scopes are separately identified.
